final: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(c.client_id), 0) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp p ON c.client_id = p.client_id AND a.account_id = p.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
